data.item: The Directors of Home Afrika limited are pleased to announce the unaudited Group results for the 6 Months period ended 30th June 2016 (A). CONSOLIDATED STATEMENT OF PROFIT OR LOSS AND OTHER COMPREHENSIVE INCOME 6 Months to 30 June 2016 2015 Shs ‘000’ Shs ‘000’ Revenue 54,346 216,843 Cost of sales (38,286) (219,820) Gross profit /(loss) 16,060 (2,977) Other operating income 5,473 39,832 Selling and distribution expenses (7,025) (21,753) Administration expenses (41,611) (63,284) Other operating expenses (15,957) (11,186) Operating loss (43,060) (59,368) Finance costs (53,958) (52,740) Loss for the period (97,018) (112,108) Tax charge (2,396) (6,247) Total Comprehensive Loss for the period (99,414) (118,355) Profit attributable to: -Owners of the parent (96,468) (112,997) -Non –controlling interest (2,946) (5,358) (99,414) (118,355) (Loss)/earnings per share -basic and diluted (0.24) (0.28) (B). CONDENSED STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL POSITION As at June As at December 2016 2015 Shs’000’ Shs ‘000’ CAPITAL EMPLOYED 405,255 405,255 Share capital 68,842 68,842 Share premium (649,285) (552,816) Accumulated deficit (175,188) (78,719) Equity attributable to owners of the company 34,065 37,010 Non –Controlling interest 767,995 773,420 Non- current liabilities 626,872 731,711 REPRESENTED BY 798,164 801,416 Non-current assets 3,106,981 3,060,900 Current assets (3,278,273) (3,130,605) Current liabilities 171,292 69,705 Net current assets 626,872 731,711 Explanatory notes: These results are extracted from the unaudited consolidated financial statements of Home Afrika Limited for the 6 months FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS The Group narrowed its losses by 16% from Kshs. 118Million to Kshs. 99Million respectively in the six months through June 2016 compared to the same period last year. The Group restructuring and Cost rationalization measures began to bear fruit with a significant reduction in the operating expenses by 33% from Kshs. 96Million to Kshs. 65Million in the six months through June 2016 compared to the same period last year. The book value (reported at cost) of the inventories available for sale went up by Kshs. 50Million from Kshs.2.91Billion in 2015 to Kshs. 2.96Billion in 2016. The value of our inventory at the completion of the project is estimated at Shs Kshs. 6Billion. Deferred income and deposits from sale of plots grew by Kshs. 89Million from Kshs. 1.76Billion to Kshs. 1.84Billion. These represent revenue to be recognized in the income statement in subsequent period pro-rata to the ongoing infrastructure works at site based on percentage of completion. The directors remain confident of the substantial underlying long term value and profit generation in the periods ahead. The directors do not recommend a dividend for the period ending 30th June 2016 Dan Awendo Managing Director 30th August, 2016
